name: vertex-ai-token-monitor
description: Shows today's Vertex AI publisher-model input/output token usage in the VS Code status bar using Google Cloud Monitoring.

vertexTokenMonitor.projectId.markdownDescription: Google Cloud project ID. Leave blank to use the active project from `gcloud config get-value project`.

vertexTokenMonitor.gcloudPath.markdownDescription: Path or command name for the Google Cloud CLI. On Windows, plain `gcloud` is automatically changed to `gcloud.cmd`.

vertexTokenMonitor.billingExportTable.markdownDescription: Fully qualified BigQuery table of the Cloud Billing export, e.g. `my-billing-project.billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXXXX_XXXXXX_XXXXXX`. When set, actual costs (today and month-to-date) are shown. Leave blank to disable. The export lags real time by hours.

vertexTokenMonitor.billingQueryProjectId.markdownDescription: Project in which the BigQuery billing query job runs (and is billed). Leave blank to use the monitored project.

vertexTokenMonitor.billingServiceDescrip.markdownDescription: Only count billing rows whose `service.description` equals this value. Leave blank to include every service in the project.

vertexTokenMonitor.extraFilter.markdownDescription: Optional additional Cloud Monitoring filter appended to the Vertex token metric filter. Example: `resource.labels.model_user_id="gemini-2.5-pro"`. Leave blank to count all Vertex publisher-model traffic in the project.
